rule: After checkpoint200 dev is verified, stop for futility if max(checkpoint100,checkpoint200) Macro-F1 is below warm-start full-dev Macro-F1 +0.005. No test for an aborted run. If continued, retain registered final checkpoint selection over 100,200,300,400.
scope: Exploratory compute allocation rule; not a significance claim. Neutral regressions are descriptive, not an additional hidden stop criterion.
